name: Niukawakami Shrine
type: Shinto shrine; Shrines receiving Tsukinami-sai and Niiname-sai offerings; Shikinai Ronsha
text: Niukawakami Shrine (丹生川上神社, Niukawakami Jinja), also known as Nibukawakami Jinja, is a Shinto shrine located at Higashiyoshino in Nara, Japan.

depictions.name: Niukawakami Shrine
depictions.text: Niukawakami Shrine is a Shinto shrine located in southeastern Yamato, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the location and paid respect at its two smaller shrines.
